Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We27re excited to start the procurement process. Finance on our side needs to get Olive Hardware set up in your vendor master so PO processing and initial orders can flow.

Per your checklist on the call, please confirm the exact legal name and remittance address fields you require, plus a contact for PO questions and an AP email to receive invoices. I27ve attached our W-9 and a bank confirmation letter for quick reference.

Quick answers from our side:
- Legal name: Olive Hardware, Inc.
- Billing address (registered): 221 Harbor Lane, Suite 400, Portland, OR 97209, USA
- Remit-to (preferred): ACH to our bank (details available on bank letter)
- Primary procurement contact: Sofia Ward, Senior Ops Manager (s.ward@olivehardware.com, +1 503-555-0199)
- AP contact: invoices@olivehardware.com

Can you confirm any additional fields Redwood needs (tax jurisdiction, vendor class, PO owner)? Any preferred file format for contact lists?

Thanks,
Sofia Ward
Senior Operations Manager
Olive Hardware, Inc.

Attachments: Olive_HW_W9.pdf, Olive_HW_BankLetter.pdf

Hi Sofia 26 team,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. I27ll loop in AP (Kimberly) and our procurement ops owner (Jordan) to capture the vendor profile and map PO routing.

Kimberly / Jordan: please advise if the W-9 + bank letter are sufficient or if we require certificates, beneficial owner declarations, or local tax forms for OR jurisdiction. Also confirm preferred PO owner at Redwood (we usually assign PO owners by product/team; I27ll mark this one to Hardware Sourcing).

Sofia, if you can also send a short CSV (or the attached XLSX) with a named PO contact column and the email for invoice routing, that will speed things up. If you27d prefer, we can also send a vendor intake form (one page) to collect the remaining fields.

I27ll coordinate and follow up with the next steps.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the ping, Lukas.

Sofia 26 team 2D I can take this through vendor onboarding. For Redwood27s master file we27ll need the following to create the vendor record and enable PO issuance: 
1) Legal entity name (as filed): Olive Hardware, Inc.
2) Tax ID / EIN (provided on W-9)
3) Registered address (street, city, state, postal code, country)
4) Remit-to address and payment method (ACH preferred; bank letter helpful)
5) AP email for invoices (invoices@olivehardware.com)
6) Primary PO contact (name, email, phone)
7) Authorized signatory name for contract / payment agreements (name, title, email)
8) W-9 (received) and bank letter (received)
9) If non-US entity or foreign bank, we27ll need W-8 series and additional banking docs.

Deliverables / next steps:
- Sofia: please add the authorized signatory and a copy of the preferred contact list in the attached Excel. We accept CSV/XLSX.
- Jordan: once Sofia confirms, can you assign PO owner and set vendor class (we typically 'Hardware Supplier' or 'MRO')? Also indicate whether this vendor will be approved for auto-PO versus manual approvals.
- I will open the vendor master request and upload the docs to the secure intake folder; I27ll also kick off a verification of bank details with our AP team.

I27m attaching a short vendor intake form for you to complete and return. For speed, a completed spreadsheet with the fields above is fine.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
AP Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_intake_template.xlsx

Files attached: Olive_HW_Signed-PO-Contact.xlsx, Olive_HW_BankLetter.pdf, Olive_HW_W9.pdf

Let me know if you need notarized copies or any additional tax documentation. If all looks good on your side, can you confirm when the vendor record will be active and whether we should expect the first PO this quarter?

Best,
Sofia
